== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Imperial Steward]] is a high-ranking leadership position within the [[Aurelian Empire]], serving as a caretaker and protector during periods of transition. The role is intended to manage the empire's affairs while sitting on the throne until a true Emperor can be established. [[Calder Marten]], a [[Navigator]] and captain of the ship [[The Testament]], was appointed to this position by the loyal [[Guild Heads]] to provide unified leadership and defend against the incursions of the [[Great Elders]]. As Steward, [[Calder]] is tasked with representing the people, addressing crises such as atmospheric anomalies, and maintaining order among the various [[Guilds]]. The role carries significant political weight, often involving interactions with [[Regents]] and regional governors, though it can also be a source of instability; previous holders of the title have been driven to madness by the imperial throne or faced challenges from those who prefer the [[Authority{{!}}authority]] of a [[Regent]].}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] holds the title of Steward, a role through which he communicates by sending messages via senior [[Guards]]. Following an incident where the Steward's body was found pulseless and bleeding, the individual's armor had to be removed. During these events, a little girl with hair redder than the Captain's was present. Although [[Jerri]] refers to [[Calder]] as the Captain, he contemplates reclaiming his former position as Steward to further a future grudge against [[Shera]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Steward]] is a title or role held by [[Calder]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c13">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Steward]]'s body was bleeding and he had no pulse.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Steward]]'s body is wearing armor that needs to be removed.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Jerri]] refers to [[Calder]] as the Captain.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref>}}</li>
